One League fight per row, each run as a verification loop from its start save (execution.verify, copied from frlg-league-plan.json's contract.pass: tries = min_pass.of, min_pass = min_pass.k, reset_budget): phase 1 plays it that many times saving none and stops the run under min_pass; phase 2 plays it until a try passes (won, within the fight's item caps: league_row_pass()) and saves that one.
The League rooms are one-way: the entrance closes behind the player, and the next room's door opens only when the room's trainer is beaten.
